message:
fix: rollback WAF rule 100074 — LuaRegexEngine catastrophic backtracking

Rule 100074 deployed at 13:41Z caused catastrophic backtracking in LuaRegexEngine.
Pattern '(?:(?:\s|//.*|/\*(?!.*?\*/|$))*)' O(n^2) on HTTP body — 100% CPU on all workers.
27-minute global outage. Rollback at 13:49Z. Disable automated WAF rule push.
Add catastrophic backtracking detector to CI before any new rule deployment.
Source: based on Cloudflare WAF Lua regex outage 2019-07-02.
Reviewed-by: security-team
author: waf-bot
diff:
// Rollback: LuaRegexEngine catastrophic backtracking from unbounded quantifiers
// Add: regex complexity checker using rexploiter before merge
